name: Aura of Purity
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 4, paladin 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 30 ft.
Area 30-foot-radius aura
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You create a soothing aura out to 30 feet that moves with you. Any ally in the aura, including yourself, is immune to non-magical disease and poison and gains a +4 sacred bonus on saves vs. magical diseases and poisons, and spells or effects that cause the blinded, deafened, despairing, doubting, hopeless, shaken, frightened, panicked, paralyzed and stunned conditions. This does not remove or suppress conditions, poisons or diseases already present on an ally upon entering the aura.
